method.timing: One warm-up followed by seven synchronous CLI processes; median wall time includes Bun process startup.
notes: Same-revision compact/full pairs isolate representation cost; historical TE-00 bytes remain a separate longitudinal diagnostic because repository content and matching evolved.
Default partial-only topic discovery builds candidates from search results and Wiki frontmatter without a RepoView, source-glob expansion, read-order construction, or page-body context assembly.
Compact selected-work and complete-match context retain authority, status, paths, source declarations and expansion, conflict IDs, read order, body digests, and focused commands.
Full mode retains the exhaustive historical representation and exact-revision reusable-context artifacts continue to bind the exhaustive semantic model.
The local wall-time samples show no measurable latency improvement because process startup dominates; they are observations, not a pass threshold or provider-performance claim.
